source.snippet: i started holyclaude in march. a web ui for running claude on your own machine, built because i... 2.4k stars later i'm building the hosted version of it. Tags: opensource, startup, ai, devops.

problem_statement: Developers want a polished, low-friction web UI to interact with Claude (and similar LLMs) without managing local infrastructure — the open-source self-hosted version has proven demand (2.4k GitHub stars in ~5 months) and the builder is now moving to a hosted SaaS, signaling willingness to pay in this segment.
target_segment: Individual developers, small dev teams, and technical founders who use Claude API and want a managed chat UI without self-hosting overhead.
notes: 2.4k GitHub stars in ~5 months for a self-hosted Claude web UI is a strong organic demand signal. Builder is now constructing a hosted version, implying market validation and a monetization path. Comparable products (e.g., hosted ChatGPT-style UIs for other LLMs) have found paying customers at $10-20/month tiers. Buyer evidence: developers already using the open-source version represent a conversion funnel; the hosted version directly targets those unwilling to manage infrastructure. Existing competition (Claude.ai) has free tier limits, creating upgrade pressure.
